info.name: TrueYield API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for TrueYield — KI-gestützte ESG-Verifikationsplattform.

**Setup:**
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your backend URL (default: http://localhost:8080)
2. Log in via your frontend and copy the JWT from the `jwt_token` cookie into `bearerToken`

**Roles:**
- `fund-manager`: can manage portfolios, holdings, evidence, create audit reports
- `auditor`: can assign, complete and reject audit reports, add audit comments

variable.description: Auth0 JWT access token. Obtain by logging in via the frontend and copying the jwt_token cookie.

item.name: Portfolio
item.description: Manage investment portfolios. Fund Managers can create, update, and delete their own portfolios. Auditors have read-only access to all portfolios.

request.description:
Creates a new portfolio owned by the authenticated Fund Manager.

**Role required:** `fund-manager`

**Returns:** 201 Created with the created portfolio object.

Returns portfolios scoped to the caller's role:
- `fund-manager`: only their own portfolios
- `auditor`: all portfolios

**Role required:** any authenticated user

Returns a single portfolio.

**Role required:** any authenticated user

**Returns:** 200 OK, 403 Forbidden (wrong owner), 404 Not Found

Updates name and description. Only the owning Fund Manager may update.

**Role required:** `fund-manager`

**Returns:** 200 OK, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found

Deletes a portfolio. Only the owning Fund Manager may delete.

**Role required:** `fund-manager`

**Returns:** 204 No Content, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found

item.name: Holding
item.description: Manage holdings (individual securities) within a portfolio.

request.description:
Adds a holding to a portfolio. The caller must own the portfolio.

**Role required:** `fund-manager`

**Returns:** 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 403 Forbidden

Returns all holdings for a given portfolio.

**Role required:** any authenticated user

**Returns:** 200 OK with array of holdings

Deletes a holding. Caller must own the parent portfolio.

**Role required:** `fund-manager`

**Returns:** 204 No Content, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found

item.name: Evidence
item.description: Manage evidence items (news articles) linked to holdings. AI-generated sentiment score is computed on creation.

request.description:
Creates an evidence entry. Claude Haiku analyses the `contentSnippet` and stores an `aiSentimentScore` between -1.0 (negative ESG) and +1.0 (positive ESG).

**Role required:** any authenticated user with access to the holding's portfolio

**Returns:** 201 Created with sentiment score

Returns all evidence items for a given holding.

**Role required:** any authenticated user

**Returns:** 200 OK with array of evidence items including aiSentimentScore

Returns a single evidence item.

**Role required:** any authenticated user

**Returns:** 200 OK, 404 Not Found

Deletes an evidence item. Caller must have access to the holding's portfolio.

**Role required:** `fund-manager`

**Returns:** 204 No Content, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found

item.name: Audit Report
item.description: Manage the ESG audit workflow. State machine: AI_ANALYZING → PENDING_REVIEW → UNDER_REVIEW → APPROVED | REJECTED

request.description:
Creates an audit report for a portfolio.

1. Status starts as `AI_ANALYZING`
2. The Guardian API fetches news for all holdings
3. Claude Haiku generates an ESG risk summary
4. Status transitions to `PENDING_REVIEW`

**Role required:** `fund-manager`

**Returns:** 201 Created, 400 Bad Request (portfolio not found or wrong owner)

Returns a single audit report including `aiRiskSummary`, `auditStatus`, and `auditorId`.

**Role required:** `fund-manager` (own portfolio) or `auditor`

**Returns:** 200 OK, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found

Assigns the audit report to the calling auditor. Transitions status from `PENDING_REVIEW` to `UNDER_REVIEW`.

**Role required:** `auditor`

**Returns:** 200 OK, 400 Bad Request (wrong status)

Approves the audit. Only the assigned auditor can complete the report. Transitions from `UNDER_REVIEW` to `APPROVED`.

**Role required:** `auditor` (must be assigned auditor)

**Returns:** 200 OK, 400 Bad Request (wrong status or wrong auditor)

Rejects the audit. Only the assigned auditor can reject the report. Transitions from `UNDER_REVIEW` to `REJECTED`.

**Role required:** `auditor` (must be assigned auditor)

**Returns:** 200 OK, 400 Bad Request (wrong status or wrong auditor)

Returns aggregated audit report counts grouped by status for a given portfolio. Uses a MongoDB aggregation pipeline.

Example response:
```json
[
  { "id": "PENDING_REVIEW", "count": 2, "itemIds": ["..."] },
  { "id": "APPROVED", "count": 1, "itemIds": ["..."] }
]
```

**Role required:** `fund-manager` or `auditor`

**Returns:** 200 OK, 400 Bad Request (portfolio not found)

item.name: Audit Comment
item.description: Auditor comments on audit reports. Comments are immutable after creation.

request.description:
Adds a comment to an audit report. Only the assigned auditor may comment.

**Role required:** `auditor`

**Returns:** 201 Created, 400 Bad Request (report not found), 403 Forbidden

Returns all comments for a given audit report.

**Role required:** any authenticated user with access to the report

**Returns:** 200 OK with array of comments
